title: Watch the landing page demo and start a trip
description: This test verifies that a visitor can watch the landing page core-loop demo and use the primary call to action to begin the trip flow.

steps.description: Verify the core-loop demo is visible
Wait for the demo to advance through its stages
Verify the landing page presents a clear path to start a trip

title: Lock the official pick from Decision
description: An organizer can lock the top choice in Decision and see the official pick banner appear.

steps.description: Verify an official pick banner is displayed
Verify the final pick is marked as official

title: Browse recommended homes in grid view and open a listing
description: This test verifies that a visitor can browse the recommended board, switch to grid view, and open a listing detail modal.

steps.description: Verify a listing detail modal is displayed

title: Create a new trip with the required planning details
description: This test verifies that a signed-in user can complete the trip creation flow and see the new trip created.

steps.description: Verify the new trip is created

title: Create a new trip
description: This verifies that a signed-in user can create a trip with the required planning details.

steps.description: Fill in the login field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Fill in the trip name field with a unique trip name
Fill in the destination field with a valid destination
Fill in valid trip dates and budget details
Verify the new trip is created
Verify the user is taken to the new trip

title: Filter recommended homes and keep the filtered results visible
description: This test verifies that a visitor can open filters, apply lodging preferences, and see the board update to the filtered results.

steps.description: Verify the filtered homes are displayed
Verify the selected filters remain applied

title: Learn how the product works from the landing page
description: This test verifies that a visitor can jump to the explainer content and see the product highlights on the landing page.

steps.description: Click the link to learn how the product works
Verify the demo and feature sections are displayed
Verify the landing page highlights the main product workflow

title: Review Scout ranking of the shortlist
description: A user can open Scout on the Shortlist tab and see the ranked analysis of shortlisted homes.

steps.description: Verify Scout ranking results are displayed
Verify the shortlist analysis is visible

title: Open a listing and review its details
description: A visitor can open a home from the board and inspect the full listing detail modal before closing it.

steps.description: Verify the listing detail modal is displayed
Verify listing photos and key home details are displayed

title: View trips dashboard with existing trips
description: This verifies that a signed-in user can open the trips dashboard and see their trip list.

steps.description: Fill in the login field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Verify the user's trips are displayed
Verify a trip can be opened from the dashboard

title: Compare two homes with Scout
description: A user can select two shortlisted homes, run a comparison, and see the comparison verdict and table.

steps.description: Verify a comparison table is displayed
Verify a comparison verdict is visible

title: Browse more homes with the see-all expander
description: This test verifies that a visitor can expand the recommended section to reveal additional homes on the board.

steps.description: Expand the recommended section to show more homes
Verify the expanded home set remains visible

title: Change filters and see results update
description: A visitor can refine the board with filters and immediately see the listing results reflect those choices.

steps.description: Verify the board results reflect the selected filters

title: Refresh the board listings manually
description: An owner can manually refresh the board listings and see a refresh confirmation on the board.

steps.description: Verify a refresh confirmation is visible
Verify the listings remain displayed after the refresh

title: Open a trip from the dashboard
description: This verifies that a signed-in user can continue from the trips dashboard into a trip view.

steps.description: Fill in the login field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Open one of the trips in the list
Verify the selected trip is opened

title: Switch to list view and return to the recommended board
description: This test verifies that a visitor can switch between board layouts and still see the recommended homes afterward.

steps.description: Verify the homes are displayed in list view
Verify the recommended homes are displayed again

title: Review price breakdown and home details
description: A visitor can open a listing detail modal and confirm the price breakdown, amenities, and distance information are available.

steps.description: Verify the price breakdown is displayed
Verify amenities and nearby distance details are displayed

title: Apply board filters and keep them after reload
description: A visitor can change board filters and still see the same applied filters after reloading the page.

steps.description: Verify the selected filters remain applied
Verify the split setting remains applied

title: Submit a criteria request in Discussion
description: A user can submit a new must-have criterion from Discussion and see it added to the pending requests list.

steps.description: Verify the request is shown as pending

title: Delete the trip from management
description: An organizer can delete the trip from the management page and be taken to the appropriate post-delete state.

steps.description: Verify the trip is no longer accessible from the management view
Verify a deletion confirmation or empty state is displayed

title: Close voting for the trip
description: An organizer can close voting from the management page and see voting marked as closed.

steps.description: Verify voting is shown as closed
Verify the board reflects that voting is no longer open

title: Transfer the organizer role
description: An organizer can transfer organizer access to another member and see the updated ownership reflected in the management view.

steps.description: Select another member as the new organizer
Verify the organizer role is updated
Verify the selected member is shown as the organizer

title: Remove a member from the trip
description: An organizer can remove a member from the trip and see the roster update accordingly.

steps.description: Verify the member roster no longer includes the removed member

title: Page through listing photos
description: A visitor can browse through multiple photos in a listing detail modal and continue viewing the same home details afterward.

steps.description: Verify additional listing photos are displayed
Verify the modal remains open on the same listing

title: Expand Scout analysis details
description: A user can open a Scout analysis and expand the full reasoning to review the detailed explanation and red flags.

title: Review the trip management roster
description: An organizer can open the management page and see the current member roster for the trip.

steps.description: Verify the member roster is displayed
Verify trip management controls are displayed

title: Open and step through the guided tour
description: A visitor can start the board tour, advance through guidance, and complete the onboarding walkthrough.

steps.description: Click the board tour entry point
Verify the guided tour is displayed
Verify the guided tour is dismissed

title: Approve a pending criterion request
description: An organizer can approve a pending criterion request and see it move into the approved set used by Scout.

steps.description: Verify it is no longer pending

title: Reject an incomplete trip creation form
description: This test verifies that trip creation does not proceed when required planning details are missing and that the form shows validation feedback.

steps.description: Verify the trip is not created

title: Move backward and skip the guided tour
description: A visitor can revisit earlier tour steps and dismiss the tour without finishing it.

steps.description: Click the board tour entry point
Verify the guided tour is dismissed

title: Reject a pending criterion request
description: An organizer can reject a pending criterion request and see it removed from the pending set.

steps.description: Verify the request is removed from pending
Verify the pending set no longer includes the request

title: See the refresh limit message
description: An owner can attempt another manual refresh too soon and see the refresh limit message instead of another refresh.

steps.description: Verify a refresh limit message is visible

title: Open the board help page from the public trip
description: This test verifies that a visitor can access the public help content for the seeded trip and see the explainer content.

steps.description: Verify the help content is displayed
Verify the trip guidance content is visible

title: Close the listing modal with the keyboard
description: A visitor can dismiss the listing detail modal using the keyboard after opening it from the board.

steps.description: Verify the listing detail modal is closed

title: View the help guide and FAQ
description: A visitor can open the public help page and review the trip-planning guidance and FAQ content.

steps.description: Verify the how-it-works guidance is displayed

title: Read the terms of service
description: This verifies that a visitor can open and read the public terms page.

steps.description: Verify the terms of service content is displayed
Verify the legal page is readable

title: Read the privacy policy
description: This verifies that a visitor can open and read the public privacy page.

Verify the legal page is readable
